# awscc_apiportal_product_page (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::APIPortal::ProductPage. A free-form documentation page within an AWS::APIPortal::Product.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_content` (Attributes) The displayed content of the product page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--display_content))
- `product_id` (String) The identifier of the parent Product.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes List) The tags associated with the product page. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `product_page_arn` (String) The ARN of the product page.
- `product_page_id` (String) The product page identifier.
- `updated_at` (String) The timestamp when the product page was last modified.

<a id="nestedatt--display_content"></a>
### Nested Schema for `display_content`

Required:

- `body` (String) Markdown-formatted body of the product page.
- `title` (String) The title of the product page.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String)
- `value` (String)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_page.example
  identity = {
    product_page_arn = "product_page_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `product_page_arn` (String) The ARN of the product page

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_apiportal_product_page.example
  id = "product_page_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
